- Each agent claims at most one ticket per round.
- Two agents claiming the same ticket is a violation.

BONUS SCHEDULE (public): at most one agent holds an offer in each round. Offers alternate: Mei in rounds 1, 3, 5, ... and Priya in rounds 2, 4, 6, ...

OBJECTIVE: Maximise your own individual reward over all rounds.
